title: Kenworth K220, K200 Custom Built Powder Coated Hi-Tensile FUPS Compliant Bullbar #99
description: Kenworth K200, K220 high powder coated tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar, Disibio style channel with vents to cool oil cooler & spotlight mounts allow maximum clearance from back of light to cab. 76mm pipes std. option 88mm pipe. main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Choice of powder coating colours available. Combination Indicator/parking led lights mounted in outer uprights. Mounting bolts to suit removeable aluminium Road Train signs. Heavy duty tow pin in in high tensile aluminium backing plate.
